looks.label: Battle list as a target strip
looks.technique: Type filters (players, NPCs, monsters, skulls, party); sort by name, distance, age or health; distance order re-sorts on each local move; health order re-sorts on health change.

looks.label: Cooldown ring
looks.technique: Progress fills in steps of 10000/duration per 100 ms tick. Defect: increment-based (no delta-time), so jitter accumulates and the ring finishes late. Fix: percent from the start timestamp and now.

looks.label: Cooldown collapse burst (defined, not played)
looks.technique: Emitter with an attraction affector gives an inward pull. The spawn on cooldown end is commented out (hack until onEffectEnd), so the effect is not shown today. Fix: re-enable with an effect-end callback and a setting.
looks.ref: data/particles/particles.otps lines 25 (emitter), 33 (attraction affector); modules/game_cooldown/cooldown.lua lines 124-126 (commented block)

looks.label: Penalty window wording
looks.technique: One plain window; the sentence is chosen by whether the penalty is 100; a short centre-screen line says the player is dead.

looks.label: Stance ring
looks.technique: Three fight steps, chase toggle and safe-fight toggle; each sent to the engine on change. Checkbox state is inverted from its icon name (checked means unsafe).

looks.label: Per-version map memory
looks.technique: Map file name carries the client version; save on exit, load on start; .otmm mode when set.

originals.name: Target Strip
originals.idea: A short touch strip of the nearest threats, filtered by kind, re-sorted as the player moves.
originals.keep: Type filters; distance sort that re-sorts on move.
originals.change: Three slots; threat shapes instead of text; party ring; no list.

originals.name: Ready Ring
originals.idea: A ring that fills while a skill recharges and reads as ready at the end.
originals.keep: Ring fill that ends in a clear ready state.
originals.change: Wall-clock progress (fixes the increment defect); our own burst and sound on ready.

originals.name: Fallen Window
originals.idea: After a loss, one plain window says the penalty in one sentence and counts down to respawn.
originals.keep: One window; a partial-penalty sentence; short centre line.
originals.change: Respawn countdown instead of a close button; grey-out instead of a flash; our own wording.

originals.name: Stance Ring
originals.idea: A ring of three fight stances around the fighter, with a lock for chase.
originals.change: Ring selector; lock icon; a checkbox whose checked state matches its label.

originals.name: Map Memory
originals.idea: The map remembers its state between sessions and swaps between corner and full screen on one widget.
originals.keep: Save on exit, load on start; one widget, two homes.
originals.change: Our own file keys; heading arrow on the camera marker.
